## Requirements

- Python >= 3.10 (or C++ standard)
- Dependencies listed, e.g.:
  - numpy >= 1.24
  - scipy >= 1.10

## Installation

Step-by-step. Not just `pip install .`.

```bash
git clone git@github.com:ORG/REPO.git
cd REPO
pip install -e .
```

## Repository Structure

```
REPO/

├── scripts/       # Run scripts and utilities
├── docs/          # Documentation
```
